column5: [why the floor went down]: ship trust run --update-ratchet raises floors; a floor goes down only with a reason

re-based onto trust 0.11.0 (20565c325, store build 15698), a count change, no proof the code lost (per-obligation diff of both provers on one source, 2026-10-26): its floor's prover 321aaeda7 cannot build it on main since astream-wire's sync island (astream f59befa, pinned by fe1ef7de32) fails to elaborate under its Clean kernel (NOT-VERIFIED(rc=2)); with main's aterm-dbus and astream before that island (7239e0acdf plus 5b89ee747f), 321aaeda7 proves 143/436, above the old 141 (143 too on 2dbd55ec43, header_len and pad_to still const), and 20565c325 proves 136/535, the same record as on main. Per function, its 7 fewer are 13 fewer in 8 functions and 6 more in 3: 6 Box allocation null checks it does not ask (Value::array, dict, strings, variant, Reader::value 2), their bodies' allocations now unsupported_mir unknowns; 3 panic-freedom assertions it leaves runtime-checked or does not ask (Type::clone, Value::variant, frame_len's closure); Value::type_of's 3 overflow rows and its unreachable, left unknown beside a termination hypothesis for its recursion; against header_len 1 -> 4, pad_to 2 -> 4 and Value's From<&str> 0 -> 1. Measured by ship trust run -p aterm-dbus under --prover <store trust 9192>/bin and under the store default (TRUST-FLOORS, docs/AUDIT-third-party-2026-10-15.md section 7)
